name: deadpan-doodles
description: Translucent pen-and-watercolor illustrations with dry humor and playfully offbeat proportions.

interface.shortDescription: Dry humor, loose pen lines, translucent watercolor.
interface.longDescription: Draw people, animals, plants, objects, and small scenes with translucent watercolor and one meaningful proportion contrast. A dedicated portrait module handles photo likeness without turning portrait anatomy into universal rules.
defaultPrompt: Use $deadpan-doodles to draw a languid cat beside a small flower, with translucent watercolor and gently odd proportions.
用 $deadpan-doodles 根据我的照片画人物 IP，有一点反常比例和冷幽默，不要太可爱。
